name: Cost-Quality Efficiency
description: Pure-code Pareto-style metric: combines an external quality score with the agent's measured cost (from telemetry) into a score-per-dollar efficiency rating. No LLM judge involved.

expectedInputs.description: AgenticTelemetry record with TokensUsed, EstimatedCost, latency percentiles, and tool-call counts.
Quality score in [0,1] from another evaluator (e.g. task_completion) — combined with cost to compute efficiency.
